rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 and has had too many close wins and losses, including a 23-24 road loss at Texas and an 18-30 road loss at USC, which lowers its profile despite a big win over Iowa.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has the sharpest recent visual evidence, with a 41-28 road win over Ohio State and a 34-27 home win over Boise State, though its losses to Illinois and Oklahoma State look sloppy.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama and Texas A&M look convincing, but a 6-34 home-away loss to Kentucky and a 17-20 home loss to Texas keep its overall margins uneven.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech has a nine-game win streak featuring a 53-25 win over Arizona State and a 52-27 win at Oklahoma State, but its 24-37 road loss at Cincinnati is a notable concern.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with close wins over Oregon and Wisconsin, a 54-3 blowout at Maryland, and a 28-10 win over Michigan State; its only loss was a narrow 16-18 road defeat at Michigan.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia remains atop the supplied AP starting point with a 9-1 record and wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, and Ole Miss, offset only by a narrow Auburn loss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston giving its strong record direct resume support over Georgia.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes wins over Miami and SMU, though BYU's head-to-head win keeps the Irish below the unbeaten Utah and Georgia.
rationales.Miami: Miami has one loss, to Notre Dame, and its wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, and Florida State make a compelling 9-1 resume.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win over Oregon stand out, while its loss to Michigan and less imposing schedule context place it below Miami.
rationales.Texas: Texas has a strong 9-2 slate, including wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, but losses to Oklahoma and Florida prevent a higher position.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over Michigan, USC, and Nebraska; losses to Ohio State and Washington leave it behind the leading one-loss teams.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 resume features decisive wins over Alabama, LSU, and Kentucky, tempered by losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Arizona and Houston, but its road loss at Cincinnati and narrower schedule context keep it outside the top tier.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's two losses were to Georgia and Tennessee, while wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, and Kentucky support a top-10 placement.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State are substantial, but losses to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State weigh heavily against its 7-3 record.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and TCU, though losses to Utah and UCF lower it behind the stronger resumes above.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Florida and Missouri, and the packet's top ratings (FPI 28.7, SP+ 31.3) anchor the AP No. 1 spot.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona plus a 43-10 rout of Arkansas, fully supporting AP No. 2.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and blowouts of Wisconsin, Stanford and SMU; the lone BYU loss keeps it just below the two unbeatens.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win over Wake Forest, a 41-13 rout of Clemson and a win over Florida State, with only the Notre Dame loss blemishing the resume.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU and Ole Miss; the Oklahoma and Florida losses are the only reason it sits fifth.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with both losses (Ohio State, Washington) by one score.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with wins over LSU, South Carolina, Texas A&M and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee hold it behind Texas and Indiana.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a win over Oregon and road wins at Minnesota and Maryland, though a soft schedule (SOS proxy .438) tempers the AP No. 4 slot.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama plus wins over Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, with narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a win over Louisville and blowouts of SMU, Stanford and Virginia; the Miami loss is its only blemish.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 but its wins over Ohio State, USC and Boise State are the packet's strongest collection, outweighing losses to UCLA, Oklahoma State and Illinois.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State; the Cincinnati loss is the lone setback.

rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, owns wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, and has no packet-listed loss.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record with the packet’s strongest SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.675), including wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with top-tier SP+ and FPI, a win over Miami, and its sole loss to BYU on the road.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 mark includes wins over Wake Forest and Clemson, while its only loss came away at Notre Dame.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1, beat Oregon on the road, and rates highly in SP+ despite a lower SOS proxy than several peers.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with strong SP+ and FPI, plus wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska; its losses were narrow.
rationales.Texas: Texas has a 9-2 record and strong ratings, with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, though it lost to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee’s 8-2 resume includes wins over Alabama, LSU, and Kentucky, with a close loss to Texas and a road loss to South Carolina.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama’s 8-2 schedule produced wins over LSU, Texas A&M, and Florida State, but Georgia and Tennessee defeated it.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with strong ratings and wins over Louisville and SMU, though its home loss to Miami limits its standing.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with strong SP+, a win over Arizona, and a narrow win over Houston, offset by its loss at Cincinnati.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon’s 7-3 record is weighed down by losses to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State despite wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads on SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7) with a 9-1 record, including a road win over Alabama and a neutral win over Florida.

rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 7-4 record is weak, but SP+ 24.1 and FPI 23.2 reflect strong underlying efficiency and a road win at Iowa.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with SP+ 22.4 and FPI 25.4, with a road win over Ohio State and a 20-17 road win at Tennessee, offset by losses to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's SP+ (22.9) and FPI (24.2) are strong, but two losses including a home defeat to Georgia and a road loss to Tennessee cap its resume.

rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 with SP+ 18.3 and a road win over Ohio State, but losses to Illinois and Oklahoma State weigh against it.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with SP+ 21.1 and a road win at Oregon, though its only loss came at Michigan and its schedule ratings are moderate.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4 and a road win over Oklahoma State, but its strength of schedule is middling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with SP+ 21.5 and FPI 19.1, with a home win over Alabama, though its losses include South Carolina.

rationales.Utah: Utah secures the top ranking as the lone undefeated power team with direct head-to-head wins over BYU and Houston.

rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame claims third with a 10-1 record and a premier head-to-head victory against Miami.

rationales.Indiana: Indiana takes the final playoff spot at 8-2, anchored by a decisive head-to-head win over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, Oklahoma, and Missouri, and its only loss is a one-point home stumble to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU, and Missouri, and its two losses came by a combined six points.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a gauntlet SEC slate and quality wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, Florida State, and Kentucky.

rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win at Wake Forest and victories over Clemson, Florida State, and Duke, its lone loss a tight one at Notre Dame.

rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and victories over Arizona, Arizona State, and Iowa State.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, and Arizona State, its lone loss to Cincinnati.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss is 6-4 in the nation's toughest league per its 0.5755 SOS proxy, with wins over LSU, Auburn, Missouri, and Louisville.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record includes wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri, giving it the packet's strongest collection of quality victories.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 7-4 mark is tempered by four losses, but wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois and Northwestern support a strong Big Ten case.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana went 8-2 with wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Northwestern, earning the benefit of the doubt for its quality wins.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 season features impressive wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska and Michigan, though its loss to UCLA prevents a higher slot.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 record includes wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois, with the Big Ten benefit of the doubt lifting its standing.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA went 10-1 with wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, Maryland and Michigan State, offering the best Big Ten body of work.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Michigan State and Boston College outweigh its narrow loss to BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas's 9-2 season features wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU and Ole Miss, with only Oklahoma and Florida defeating it.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record includes quality wins over LSU, Kentucky, South Carolina and Mississippi State despite narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 body of work includes wins over Alabama, Auburn, LSU and Arkansas, with only Texas and South Carolina handing it defeats.
rationales.Utah: Utah completed 10-0 without a listed loss, beating BYU, Houston, Cincinnati and Arkansas along the way.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record includes wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Duke, Stanford and Pittsburgh, with only Notre Dame defeating it.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, and Missouri, giving it the packet's strongest blend of résumé and quality wins.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over Nebraska, Michigan, Northwestern, USC, and Rutgers, and its metrics support an elite top-four case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record features wins over Ohio State, USC, Michigan, and Boise State, with a 21.349 FPI and 18.3 SP+ backing a strong schedule.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU, and Missouri, although its Florida loss keeps it just below the leaders.
rationales.Utah: Utah is the only 10-0 team in the packet and has no losses, with wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati, and Arkansas.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 27.212 FPI and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Michigan State, Stanford, and Boston College.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 campaign features wins over Clemson, Wake Forest, Pittsburgh, and Florida State, with its only loss coming against Notre Dame.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 7-4 record is tempered by four losses, but wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois, Northwestern, and Maryland justify a playoff place.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a Big Ten benefit of the doubt, backed by wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Maryland, Illinois, and Minnesota.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with wins over Louisville, NC State, Purdue, Stanford, and Georgia Tech, though its Miami loss limits the ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with quality wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky, LSU, Arkansas, and Texas A&M, but its Texas loss hurts.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with wins over Kentucky, LSU, South Carolina, Florida State, and Texas A&M, while losses to Georgia and Tennessee keep it outside the top ten.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet's strongest profile, including wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, and Ole Miss, with its only loss a one-point home stumble to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with quality wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, and Iowa State, though its schedule strength appears somewhat lighter than the top SEC and Big Ten contenders.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a dominant win over Miami and several lopsided victories, and its lone loss to BYU was a close road game.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest, a rout of Clemson, and a narrow loss only to Notre Dame, giving it one of the cleanest resumes available.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with head-to-head wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss; its two losses were each by a field goal, so I rank it just behind the one-loss teams.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and narrow losses only to Ohio State and Washington, and its body of work compares favorably with other two-loss teams.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with an emphatic road win over Louisville and several blowouts, though its overall schedule strength is the softest among the one-loss contenders.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3, but its wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State are the strongest collection of victories outside the top five, offsetting three narrow losses.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with wins over LSU, Texas A&M, and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee leave it behind the teams it could not beat.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama and wins over Auburn, LSU, and Kentucky, with narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a win over Notre Dame and a 2-1 head-to-head mark among ranked Big 12 peers, though losses to Utah and UCF temper its profile.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, and Oklahoma State, but its loss to Cincinnati and lighter schedule keep it below the top tier.

rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, and Arkansas, so its unbeaten record and direct wins over ranked Big 12 contenders outweigh everything else.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's only loss is a 24-27 home game to Auburn, and its 20-17 road win at Alabama plus 42-7 win at Ole Miss give it the best combination of record and direct results.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 31-24 home win over Miami, but the 24-28 loss at BYU keeps it behind Georgia despite the superior overall record.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest and a 41-13 win at Clemson; the head-to-head loss at Notre Dame is the only thing separating it from the Irish.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with direct wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, and Ole Miss, and its two losses are by three points each to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona; the lone loss at Cincinnati is outweighed by a deep set of Big 12 wins.

rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and beat Oregon 17-15 on the road; the 16-18 loss at Michigan is the only blemish, but the weaker Big Ten slate limits the resume.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon beat Ohio State, USC, and Boise State head-to-head, but the 15-17 home loss to UCLA and the 10-21 loss at Illinois are direct results that hold it down.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona 28-17, but the 20-28 loss at Utah and the 31-39 loss at UCF keep it behind the Utes in the direct comparison.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record includes a 45-17 road win at Kentucky, but the 10-26 loss at Tennessee and 17-20 home loss to Georgia are direct results that outweigh its other wins.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Kentucky 34-6, but the 17-20 home loss to Texas and 24-27 loss at South Carolina leave it behind the Tide's broader win set.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia dominates on both sides of the ball, headlined by commanding wins over Oklahoma, Ole Miss, and an impressive road victory at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains flawless at 10-0, passing every test with authoritative victories over BYU and a resilient road triumph at Arizona.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's dominant blowout victories and a marquee win over Miami showcase elite performance despite a narrow loss at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami owns one of the nation's most lethal offenses, overwhelming opponents with blowout margins aside from a competitive defeat in South Bend.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has looked exceptionally crisp all season, suffering only a four-point loss to Ohio State while physically dominating USC and Maryland.
rationales.Texas: Texas passes the eye test against elite competition, boasting victories over Tennessee, Ohio State, and Ole Miss despite two tight defeats.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA boasts a 10-1 record with a signature road victory over Oregon and several dominant multi-score conference blowouts.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama displays enormous firepower with 45-plus points in multiple SEC games, only faltering in tight finishes against top-tier teams Georgia and Tennessee.

rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech plays an explosive brand of football, racking up 50-plus points regularly while winning key matchups over Houston and Arizona.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest lights up the scoreboard with ruthless efficiency, scoring 50 or more in three conference matchups and winning at Louisville.
rationales.BYU: BYU owns high-quality wins over Notre Dame and Arizona while proving tough in physical Big 12 battles.

rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1, with its one loss a 24-37 setback at Cincinnati, and wins over Houston and Arizona were comfortable.
rationales.Boise State: Boise State's only losses were a 20-22 home loss to San Diego State and a 27-34 road loss at Oregon, while wins were mostly lopsided.

rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee sits behind Texas due to their head-to-head defeat, but holds strong over Alabama thanks to a decisive 26-10 direct victory.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama lands at seven, losing out directly to Georgia and Tennessee but maintaining an elite resume with a head-to-head win over Kentucky.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA boasts a 10-1 record with a head-to-head road win over Oregon, though their lighter non-conference strength leaves them just behind the top SEC tier.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest stands at 9-1 with a premier road win at Louisville, slotting just behind Miami after falling to the Hurricanes directly.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech earns the tenth spot at 9-1, bolstered by head-to-head victories over conference foes Arizona and Houston.
rationales.BYU: BYU ranks eleventh with high-caliber wins including a head-to-head triumph over Notre Dame and a direct victory over Arizona.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana takes the final playoff position at 8-2, justified by a convincing 27-13 head-to-head victory over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best resume in the packet: road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss plus a neutral rout of Florida, with only a home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee on the road, and Ole Miss, and its two losses came by a field goal to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's road wins at LSU and Kentucky and home rout of Texas A&M outweigh narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama, LSU, Auburn, and Kentucky, with only a field-goal loss to Texas and a road loss at South Carolina.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, and TCU, though its schedule proxy is thinner than the SEC contenders'.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is at Notre Dame, and it owns a road win at Wake Forest plus a rout of Clemson.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head and has double-digit wins over Wisconsin, SMU, and Stanford, with only a road loss at BYU.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss beat Louisville on a neutral field and LSU, but the home loss to Georgia and road loss at Florida cap its case.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, and Oklahoma State, its lone loss coming at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona and won at Kansas, with losses at Utah and UCF.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and a one-score loss at Michigan, though its schedule proxy is modest.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC and won at Nebraska and Michigan, with tight losses to Ohio State and Washington.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet's best quality wins, beating Alabama, Ole Miss, Florida, Oklahoma and Missouri, and its only loss was a one-point home slip to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Ohio State plus wins at Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU and Missouri, and both losses were by one score.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 body of work includes road wins at LSU, Kentucky and Vanderbilt plus a 50-36 win over Florida State, and its two losses were by a combined six points.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama and wins over Auburn, LSU and Texas A&M, with both losses by one score.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston and Arkansas, but its schedule lacks the marquee wins of the SEC leaders.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant victories over Wisconsin, USC-rival SMU and Stanford, losing only at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win over Notre Dame and a 41-13 rout at Clemson, its lone blemish a four-point loss at Notre Dame.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with both losses by four points to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a head-to-head win at Oregon and wins over Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota, though its schedule lacks elite wins.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and blowouts of SMU, Virginia and Stanford, losing only to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State, its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona plus a road win at TCU, with losses to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record, elite 28.675 FPI, and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss give it the strongest on-field case.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State combines a 7-4 record with a 23.2 FPI and quality wins over Iowa, Indiana, and Illinois, earning Big Ten benefit of the doubt.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 mark, 20.765 FPI, and wins over USC, Nebraska, and Michigan make it a strong Big Ten contender.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record and 21.349 FPI are reinforced by wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska, and Michigan State.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and 21.1 SP+ are supported by eight notable wins, including a victory over Oregon and a 54-3 rout of Maryland.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 record, 15.651 FPI, and wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern, and Illinois justify a top-six Big Ten placement.
rationales.USC: USC's 8-3 record and wins over Ohio State, Penn State, and Maryland outweigh losses to Oregon and Indiana.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record, 27.212 FPI, and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Stanford, and Michigan State make it a top-eight threat.
rationales.Texas: Texas's 9-2 record and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri offset narrow losses to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Utah: Utah's undefeated 10-0 season, 19.374 FPI, and wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, and Arkansas give it a complete résumé.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record and 24.21 FPI feature eight notable wins, including LSU and Florida State, despite narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record, 24.282 FPI, and eight notable wins are strengthened by a head-to-head victory over Wake Forest.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record, elite 28.675 FPI, and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss give it the strongest on-field case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 Big Ten résumé includes wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska, and Michigan State, earning the benefit of the doubt on schedule quality.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana went 8-2 with wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan, and Northwestern, while its 20.765 FPI supports a top-four placement.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State owns a 23.2 FPI and strong wins over Iowa, Indiana, and Illinois despite four losses, including narrow defeats to Texas and USC.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 finish includes wins over Michigan, Washington, Wisconsin, and Illinois, though its 0.4482 SOS proxy keeps it below the other elite Big Ten teams.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA completed a 10-1 season with wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Maryland, giving the Big Ten another strong top-six résumé.
rationales.Texas: Texas went 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, supported by a 25.373 FPI despite losses to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record includes wins over Kentucky, LSU, Florida State, and Mississippi State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee prevent a higher finish.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee went 8-2 with wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky, and LSU, though its close loss to Texas and narrow defeat by South Carolina show vulnerability.
rationales.Utah: Utah finished 10-0 without a notable loss, beating BYU, Houston, Arizona, and Arkansas with a 19.374 FPI.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record and 27.212 FPI are strengthened by wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Stanford, and Michigan State, with only BYU defeating it.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 campaign features wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Duke, and Pittsburgh, with its only loss coming against Notre Dame.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, Oklahoma and Missouri, and its lone loss was a one-point home game against Auburn; the packet's strongest body of work, though I acknowledge residual uncertainty about margin-based evaluation.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona plus a 43-10 rout of Arkansas; an unbeat­en Power-conference profile is difficult to discount, even with a modest nonconference slate.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, and its losses (Oklahoma, Florida) came by a combined six points; the quality of wins edges it ahead of Alabama in my judgment, though the order is debatable.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a marquee Florida State win and victories over LSU, South Carolina and Texas A&M, but head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee cap its ceiling.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with its only loss a four-point road game at BYU, plus wins over Miami, USC-adjacent quality foes like Michigan State and a 41-13 neutral win over Wisconsin; the lone blemish is narrow, so I place it fifth.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with its only loss a seven-point game at Notre Dame, and it owns wins over Clemson, Florida State and Wake Forest; the head-to-head loss to the Irish is the main reason it sits below them.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and victories over Wisconsin, Minnesota and Illinois; the schedule proxy is the softest among the one-loss contenders, which tempers but does not erase its record.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and competitive losses only to Ohio State (by four) and Washington (by three); the resume is solid but lacks the top-line wins of the teams above it.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a home win over Alabama and victories over Auburn, Kentucky and LSU; losses to Texas (by three) and South Carolina keep it out of the top eight.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and Arizona, but losses to Utah and UCF and a narrower overall profile place it tenth.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with its only loss to Miami, plus wins over Louisville, SMU and Virginia; the schedule proxy is comparatively light, so I stop short of the top ten.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with its only loss to Cincinnati, and wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State; the packet's metrics support it, though its schedule proxy is the lightest of the one-loss group.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best resume: wins at Alabama (20-17), at Ole Miss (42-7), and over Florida, with only a one-score loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 and swept its head-to-heads, beating BYU 28-20, Houston 21-13, and Arizona 40-39.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Tennessee 20-17 on the road and Ohio State 24-23, though the Florida home loss keeps it below the unbeatens.
rationales.Miami: Miami's lone loss came at Notre Dame 24-31, but its wins at Wake Forest (33-20) and Clemson (41-13) anchor a 9-1 mark.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami 31-24 head-to-head, but the loss at BYU (24-28) and weaker schedule strength leave it just behind.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins at Kentucky and over Texas A&M are strong, but head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee cap its placement.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Kentucky 34-6, with its two losses by a combined six points to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona 28-17, but the road loss to Utah (20-28) and the UCF stumble weigh against it.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC 27-13 and Michigan on the road; its narrow home loss to Ohio State (15-19) is the resume's main blemish.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and beat Oregon 17-15 on the road, with only an 18-16 loss at Michigan separating it from an unbeaten season.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest beat Louisville 30-27 on the road, but the home loss to Miami (20-33) is the direct result that keeps it below the Hurricanes.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech beat Houston 28-26 and Arizona 34-26 head-to-head, with only a road loss at Cincinnati marring a 9-1 record.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia passes every visual test with blowout SEC wins over Oklahoma, Ole Miss, and Florida alongside a road victory at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains undefeated at 10-0 while proving its mettle in a thrilling 40-39 road victory over Arizona and a complete handling of BYU.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's dominant defense and convincing 31-24 victory over Miami showcase an elite team playing at the highest level.
rationales.Miami: Miami has steamrolled opponents by huge margins and its lone loss came in a competitive one-score battle in South Bend.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech boasts a sparkling 9-1 record with powerful, high-scoring offensive performances and head-to-head triumphs over Arizona and Houston.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama looks ferocious when clicking, routing Kentucky, LSU, and South Carolina with only narrow defeats against elite opposition.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA owns a signature road victory at Oregon and an impressive 10-1 record with overwhelming defensive showings.
rationales.Texas: Texas possesses immense top-end firepower seen in wins over Tennessee and Ohio State, despite a couple of tight slip-ups.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee controls games with suffocating physical dominance, punctuated by a 26-10 beatdown of Alabama.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks electrifying on the field, blowing out conference foes by 40-plus points and winning at Louisville.
rationales.BYU: BYU proved its toughness by taking down Notre Dame, displaying relentless execution across an 8-2 campaign.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana plays sharp, clean football highlighted by a sound two-touchdown victory over USC and a tight four-point battle with Ohio State.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's most convincing wins came by margin, including a 42-7 road rout of Ole Miss and a 70-20 home win, though its lone loss was a close one to Auburn.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech won 9 of 10 with comfortable margins such as 53-25 over Arizona State and 52-27 at Oklahoma State, offset by a narrow loss at Cincinnati.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten with wins that were mostly controlled, though its closest results were a 40-39 road win at Arizona and a 28-20 home win over BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami rolled through its league with a 52-23 home win over Pittsburgh and a 45-6 win at Stanford, its only loss a close one to Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 body of work includes a 41-13 neutral-site win over Wisconsin, but the 24-28 loss to BYU is a blemish on an otherwise dominant profile.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama beat Georgia-level margins rarely, and its 17-20 home loss to Georgia plus a 10-26 road loss to Tennessee leave its profile uneven despite a 49-18 win over South Carolina.
rationales.Texas: Texas's wins over Ohio State (24-23) and Ole Miss (34-27) were close, but its late-season 34-20 road win at Missouri and 31-3 home win over Mississippi State show steady control.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's strongest wins came by solid margins over Maryland (45-16) and Illinois (42-19), though losses to Texas (23-24) and Oregon (28-41) weigh on its eye test.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's convincing 41-28 road win over Ohio State and 45-7 rout of Michigan State strengthen its case, though 10-21 at Illinois and a 31-39 loss at Oklahoma State are concerns.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 home win over Alabama and 34-6 rout of Kentucky stand out, but its close 20-17 loss to Texas and a 24-27 home loss to South Carolina temper the case.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record includes a close 17-15 road win over Oregon and a 17-7 home win over Wisconsin, but its one loss came by two at Michigan, and its margins are narrow.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has a strong win over Ohio State at 19-15 and 27-13 over USC, though its 13-6 win at Michigan and 15-19 home loss to Ohio State keep it in the middle tier.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Florida and Ole Miss, and its sole loss was a narrow home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, with victories over BYU, Arizona and Houston, making the strongest case to challenge Georgia for the top spot.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 mark includes decisive wins over Clemson and Wake Forest; its only loss came at Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and multiple strong victories, while its sole defeat was a close road loss at BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas owns wins over Ohio State, Tennessee and Ole Miss, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it behind the leading one-loss contenders.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon’s wins over Ohio State, USC and Boise State are excellent, but its losses to UCLA, Illinois and Oklahoma State temper the résumé.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee has beaten Alabama, LSU and Kentucky, but its narrow home loss to Texas and road loss at South Carolina leave it below the top tier.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama’s schedule is demanding and its wins include LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee weigh heavily.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and beat Oregon on the road; the low schedule proxy and absence of another comparable top-tier win keep it just outside the top eight.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has an 8-2 record with wins over USC and Michigan, but its home loss to Ohio State and road loss to Washington are significant.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and strong margins in several wins, though its home loss to Miami and schedule context limit its ceiling.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona and TCU, but its losses to Utah and UCF outweigh its strong schedule profile.

rationales.Georgia: Anchored to the prior committee release, Georgia stays No. 1 at 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri and only a one-point home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Arizona and Houston, the strongest unblemished resume in the packet.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama keeps the No. 3 slot at 8-2, with marquee wins over LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State offsetting narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA holds at 10-1 after beating Oregon on the road, with its only loss a two-point defeat at Michigan.
rationales.Texas: Texas stays fifth at 9-2, having beaten Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, with losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and a 24-3 shutout of SMU, its lone loss a four-point road defeat at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami remains ninth-in-class at 9-1, with wins over Clemson, Florida State and Wake Forest and only a road loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana stays at 8-2 with a head-to-head win over USC and close losses only to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee holds at 8-2 with wins over Alabama, Auburn and LSU, its losses coming to Texas and South Carolina by a combined six points.
rationales.BYU: BYU stays at 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona and Iowa State, offset by losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest keeps its slot at 9-1, with a road win over Louisville and a lone loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech rises on a 9-1 mark with wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State and one loss to Cincinnati.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record with the packet's best FPI (28.675) and SP+ (31.3), plus wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, owns wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston, and rates strongly in FPI and SP+ despite a more modest schedule proxy.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record, top-tier FPI and SP+, and wins over Miami and SMU outweigh its narrow road loss to BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with elite ratings and a strong set of wins, including Clemson, Wake Forest, and Florida State; its sole loss came at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas has a 9-2 record and high schedule proxy, with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU, and Missouri, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper its case.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with excellent FPI and SP+ and wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, but its home loss to Ohio State and road loss to Washington count against it.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 resume features wins over Alabama, LSU, and Kentucky, supported by strong ratings; its losses to Texas and South Carolina keep it below the top group.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and rates well, with a road win over Oregon and several solid Big Ten victories, though its schedule proxy is comparatively low and it lost at Michigan.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and TCU and a strong schedule proxy, but its losses to Utah and UCF prevent a higher placement.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 mark and strong efficiency ratings are backed by wins over Louisville and SMU, while the home loss to Miami is its key blemish.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, and Arizona State and solid ratings, but its loss at Cincinnati and less imposing schedule proxy weigh against it.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has a strong schedule proxy and wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State, but three losses—including to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State—lower its standing.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads on SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7) and owns a 9-1 record with a win at Alabama and a neutral-site win over Florida.
rationales.Texas: Texas posts a 9-2 mark with an SP+ of 22.4 and wins over Ohio State and Tennessee, though its losses to Florida and Oklahoma keep it below Georgia.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with the strongest FPI among independents (27.2) and an SP+ of 25.6, anchored by a win at Miami and a 41-13 neutral win over Wisconsin.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has an SP+ of 22.9 and a win at Kentucky, but its losses to Georgia and Tennessee cap its metrics-based standing.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 with a 21.7 SP+, though its wins are mostly against middling opponents with fewer marquee results.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with an SP+ of 24.4 and a road win at Wake Forest and Clemson, but its strength of schedule and FPI trail the top tier.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State sits at 7-4 with a 24.1 SP+ and a strong SOS proxy, but its losses to Texas, USC, and Oregon drag its resume.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a 23.1 SP+ and a win over USC, though its profile lacks elite opponents beyond Ohio State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 21.5 SP+ and wins over Alabama and Texas A&M, offset by losses to South Carolina and Kentucky-level inconsistency.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with an SP+ of 21.1 and a win at Oregon, but its only loss is to Michigan and its competition is weaker than the teams above.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with a 19.4 SP+ and a win over Arizona, but its margin profile is less dominant than the top tier.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has an SP+ of 18.3 and wins over Ohio State and USC, yet losses to UCLA and Illinois limit its consistency.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia holds the top spot boasting a dominant resume featuring a direct 20-17 road win over Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Undefeated Utah secures the second seed backed by head-to-head victories over BYU and Houston.
rationales.Texas: Texas takes third ahead of Tennessee having defeated the Volunteers 20-17 on the road.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee sits fourth on the strength of their direct 26-10 head-to-head triumph over Alabama.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama rounds out the top five holding an exceptional resume despite head-to-head defeats against Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame claims sixth propelled by a head-to-head 31-24 victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami places seventh with a 9-1 mark highlighted by an emphatic 33-20 road win over Wake Forest.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest stands eighth with only one loss to Miami and a quality road win at Louisville.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech earns ninth at 9-1 behind direct wins over both Houston and Arizona.
rationales.UCLA: Ten-win UCLA slots tenth owning a direct 17-15 victory over Oregon.
rationales.BYU: BYU is ranked eleventh possessing a direct 28-24 win over Notre Dame and a loss only to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana takes twelfth with an 8-2 record bolstered by a 27-13 head-to-head win over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet's best FPI and wins at Alabama, at Ole Miss, over Florida and Oklahoma; the lone loss was a 3-point home game to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with no notable losses and head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona, plus a 43-10 win over Arkansas.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 includes a road rout of Kentucky and wins over LSU, Texas A&M and South Carolina, with losses only to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, and both losses came by three points.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest and a 41-13 win at Clemson; the only loss is a 7-point game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1, beat Miami head-to-head, and owns a neutral-site win over Wisconsin; the lone loss came at BYU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 includes a home win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with close losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama and LSU and won at Texas A&M; the two losses were a 3-point home game to Texas and a 3-point road game at South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a home win over Notre Dame and a road win at Kansas, and both losses came away from home.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona plus a 52-27 win at Oklahoma State.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and wins over Wisconsin and Illinois; the only loss is a 2-point game at Michigan.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win at Louisville and a 50-point win over Georgia Tech, and the lone loss came to Miami.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins at Alabama, over Oklahoma, Florida and Ole Miss, and its lone loss was a one-score home upset to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win at Ohio State, a road win at Tennessee, and wins over Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, with both losses by one score.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with quality wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina and Florida State, and its only losses were one-score games against Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a home win over Alabama plus Auburn, LSU and Texas A&M, losing only by three to Texas and on the road at South Carolina.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona and a 43-10 rout of Arkansas, though its schedule lacks a second marquee win.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a home win over Miami and blowouts of Wisconsin, SMU and Stanford, its only loss a four-point road game at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a 41-13 win at Clemson and a win over Florida State, its lone loss a seven-point road game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with dominant wins over SMU, Louisville and Virginia, its only loss a 13-point home game against Miami.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a home win over Notre Dame plus Arizona, Arizona State and Iowa State, losing only at Utah and at UCF.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State, its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 with wins over Ohio State, USC and Boise State, but road losses to Oklahoma State and Illinois and a home upset by UCLA hold it back.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a home win over USC and a near-miss at Ohio State, losing by four at home to the Buckeyes and by three at Washington.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs a 9-1 record with wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss and Oklahoma, giving it the packet's strongest collection of quality victories.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 campaign includes eight wins over Big Ten opposition and a head-to-head victory over Oregon, supporting the strongest Big Ten case.
rationales.Texas: Texas won nine games and defeated Tennessee, Ohio State, Ole Miss and LSU, though losses to Florida and Oklahoma temper that résumé.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with eight notable wins, including a neutral-site victory over Wisconsin and a home win against Miami.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's eight wins include victories over USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Northwestern, while its only notable defeat came against Ohio State.
rationales.Utah: Utah is the only undefeated candidate at 10-0, with quality wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati and Houston and no notable losses.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's seven wins include decisive victories over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska and Michigan State, although three losses prevent a top-five placement.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State remains 7-4 with strong wins over Iowa, Indiana and Illinois, but losses to Texas, USC, Oregon and Nebraska expose its inconsistency.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record includes eight notable wins and only a loss to Notre Dame, giving it an excellent body of work despite the head-to-head result.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with eight notable wins, including Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State, plus a win over Baylor in the finale.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's eight wins include Michigan, Washington, Wisconsin, Illinois and Purdue, and the Big Ten slate supports a favorable read despite its Ohio State loss.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee went 8-2 with quality wins over Alabama, Auburn, LSU and Arkansas, losing narrowly to Texas and South Carolina.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record, elite 28.675 FPI, and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss give it the strongest on-field case.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 25.373 FPI and quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 Big Ten résumé includes wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State, giving it the conference's strongest quality wins.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a 20.765 FPI and wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan, and Northwestern.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 but has a 23.2 FPI and quality wins over Iowa, Indiana, and Illinois despite four losses.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 21.1 SP+ and wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Maryland.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with a 19.374 FPI and notable wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati, and Arkansas.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 27.212 FPI and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Stanford, and Michigan State.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a 24.21 FPI and wins over Kentucky, LSU, Florida State, and Texas A&M.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 19.071 FPI and quality wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky, and LSU.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with a 19.4 SP+ and wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, and Oregon State.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a 24.282 FPI and decisive wins over Stanford, Pittsburgh, Clemson, and Wake Forest.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet's strongest metrics (FPI 28.7, SP+ 31.3) and head-to-head wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss; the lone Auburn loss is the only blemish, though I acknowledge some uncertainty about a one-point home defeat.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, and Cincinnati, and its 21.7 SP+ supports a top-two slot even with a relatively lighter Big 12 slate.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with an elite strength-of-schedule proxy (0.53) and wins over LSU, South Carolina, and Texas A&M; losses to Georgia and Tennessee keep it out of the top two.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a head-to-head win at Oregon and wins over Wisconsin, Illinois, and Minnesota; its softer schedule proxy (0.438) tempers enthusiasm but the record and resume warrant a bye.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a strong schedule (0.588 proxy) and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss; losses to Oklahoma and Florida are the only negatives.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with the second-best FPI (27.2) and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, and SMU; the one-point loss at BYU is its lone blemish.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a 24.4 SP+ and a quality road win at Wake Forest plus a win over Clemson; its only loss came at Notre Dame, which the committee weighs contextually.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC and Nebraska and narrow losses to Ohio State and Washington; its 23.1 SP+ supports a top-eight position despite the close defeats.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a signature win over Alabama and wins over Auburn, Kentucky, and LSU; losses to Texas and South Carolina keep it just outside the top eight.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona, though losses to Utah and UCF prevent a higher slot; its 18.0 SP+ remains strong.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with an emphatic road win over SMU and a win over Louisville; the loss to Miami and a modest schedule proxy (0.43) leave some uncertainty about its ceiling.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, and Oklahoma State; its lone loss at Cincinnati and a moderate schedule keep it at the edge of the bye line, with Oregon, Ohio State, Iowa, Kentucky, Boise State, USC, Arizona, Houston, Louisville, Florida, Ole Miss, Liberty, and North Dakota State rounding out the field on body of work, head-to-head results, and available metrics, acknowledging that several mid-major candidates (Memphis, UTSA, New Mexico, Air Force, Louisiana Tech, Toledo) were evaluated but fell short on strength of schedule.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record and three head-to-head wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss make the Bulldogs the clear top team despite the Auburn loss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 and swept its direct Big 12 tests against BYU, Houston, and Arizona, so the unbeaten record and head-to-head results carry the day.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest; its only loss came at Notre Dame, so the Hurricanes edge the Irish's otherwise strong resume.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Tennessee and Ohio State head-to-head and owns a 9-2 SEC record, outweighing the home loss to Florida.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes a home win over Miami, but the head-to-head loss at BYU and weaker schedule strength keep the Irish behind the Longhorns.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins over Kentucky and LSU are solid, but head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee place the Tide below both SEC rivals.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Kentucky 34-6, and its narrow loss to Texas is the main reason it sits just behind the Tide's stronger schedule.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head, but the road loss to Utah and the UCF defeat keep the Cougars behind the one-loss Irish.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's home loss to Ohio State is offset by a win over USC and quality Big Ten road wins, keeping the Hoosiers narrowly ahead of Wake Forest.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win at Louisville, but the home loss to Miami is the direct result that keeps the Demon Deacons behind the Hoosiers.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona; the lone loss at Cincinnati is the only blemish on a strong Big 12 resume.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and beat Oregon head-to-head on the road, but the weak schedule and Michigan loss leave the Bruins below the Big 12 leaders.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia dominates elite opponents on the scoreboard, backed by an overwhelming +35 point margin over Ole Miss and a road victory at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains unblemished at 10-0 with consistent multi-score control over ranked contenders BYU and Houston.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame looks exceptionally physical and balanced, blowing out quality foes and avenging their lone tight defeat with a dominant win over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami boasts eye-popping blowout margins across the board, only stumbling in a hard-fought battle at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas passes the eye test with dynamic playmakers and head-to-head triumphs over Tennessee and Ohio State.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA has controlled games with authority, claiming a top-shelf road win at Oregon while dominating nearly every week.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama possesses an electric ceiling and blowout wins over LSU and South Carolina, though a 16-point loss at Tennessee stings.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee dismantled Alabama by 16 points and handled LSU convincingly, displaying elite line-of-scrimmage dominance.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's explosive offense has shredded defenses in nine victories, highlighted by high-scoring wins over Houston and Arizona.
rationales.BYU: BYU proved its high-level execution with a marquee victory over Notre Dame and a strong 8-2 resume.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks ferocious during an offensive surge that includes four consecutive blowouts scoring 41 points or more.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has suffocated opponents defensively, holding Michigan to six points and dominating USC by two touchdowns.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 70-20 rout of Western Kentucky and 42-7 win at Ole Miss show dominant margins, with its only loss a close 24-27 home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State 24-23 on the road and Ole Miss 34-27, and its 9-2 record includes two narrow wins over Tennessee and Florida-adjacent resumes.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 17-20 loss to Georgia was close, but wins over Florida State 50-36, Mississippi State 56-23 and LSU 31-13 show strong, lopsided play.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes a 49-10 rout of Purdue, 58-7 over Stanford and a 41-13 win over Wisconsin, reflecting dominant margins.
rationales.Miami: Miami has a 9-1 record with a 52-23 win over Pittsburgh and a 45-6 rout at Stanford, though its best win was a close 33-20 road victory at Wake Forest.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State beat Iowa 31-14 and Indiana 19-15 on the road, but its losses to Texas by one point and USC 18-30 show inconsistent play.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten with a 40-39 road win at Arizona and a 21-13 win over Houston, though its margins are mostly tight.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 road win at Oregon and a 54-3 rout of Maryland, a strong profile despite the lone loss to Michigan.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 win over Alabama and 34-6 rout of Kentucky are strong, though a 17-20 home loss to Texas and a 24-27 loss to South Carolina temper the profile.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana won 52-16 over North Texas and 38-0 over Western Kentucky, with its only losses coming on the road at Washington by three and a 15-19 home defeat to Ohio State.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's 9-1 record features a 53-48 home win over West Virginia and a 29-7 road win at Colorado, with its only loss a 24-37 road game at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU has a 28-24 win over Notre Dame and a 17-10 road win at TCU, but its 8-2 mark carries a 20-28 road loss to Utah and a 31-39 loss at UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads the supplied CFP ranking and owns a 9-1 record, including road wins over Alabama and Ole Miss and a neutral-site win over Florida.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston that strengthen its case beyond its second-place CFP position.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1, and its 31-24 win over Notre Dame plus wins over Clemson and Wake Forest make a strong resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record and wins over Miami and SMU outweigh its narrow road loss to BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas has an 9-2 record and valuable wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it below the unbeaten teams.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's wins over Ohio State, USC, Boise State, and Michigan stand out, despite losses to UCLA, Oklahoma State, and Illinois.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record features wins over Alabama, LSU, and Kentucky, with its Texas loss a narrow three-point result.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, TCU, and Iowa State, but its losses to Utah and UCF hold it below the leading group.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record includes a road win over Oregon and solid wins over Illinois and Wisconsin; the packet lists only a narrow loss to Michigan.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 resume includes wins over LSU, Texas A&M, and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee offset them.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 and has beaten Arizona and Houston, while its road loss to Cincinnati is its lone defeat.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, but its home loss to Ohio State and road loss to Washington restrain its placement.

rationales.Georgia: No AP poll was supplied, so this ranking is built from packet resumes and metrics; Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri and the packet's best ratings profile.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with quality wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, Iowa State and TCU, though its schedule proxy is mid-pack.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with its only loss a one-score road defeat at BYU, plus wins over Miami, Wisconsin, SMU and North Carolina.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1, losing only at Notre Dame, with a strong ACC slate including Clemson, Florida State, Pittsburgh and Virginia Tech.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a top-tier SEC schedule, beating Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, with narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and wins against Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota, its lone loss a two-point defeat at Michigan.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with an elite SP+ profile, routing SMU, Stanford, Virginia and Georgia Tech, its only loss to Miami.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a gauntlet SEC slate, beating LSU, South Carolina, Texas A&M and Florida State, falling narrowly to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati, holding wins over Arizona, Houston, Oklahoma State and Arizona State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a signature win over Alabama and wins at Georgia Tech and Texas A&M, losing close games to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska, its two losses by a combined eight points to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and wins over Arizona, Arizona State and Iowa State, losing to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet’s best FPI (28.675) and SP+ (31.3), plus wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, with an 8-0 listed win total and decisive Big 12 head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame’s 10-1 record, 27.212 FPI, and wins over Miami and SMU outweigh its narrow loss at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with 24.4 SP+ and a strong slate of wins, including Wake Forest and Clemson, though it lost to Notre Dame.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA’s 10-1 record includes a road win over Oregon and an SP+ of 21.1; its loss to Michigan is narrow, though its SOS proxy is modest.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with 25.373 FPI and a 0.5884 SOS proxy, and it beat Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss; losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper the résumé.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with 23.1 SP+ and wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, while its close home loss to Ohio State and road loss to Washington matter.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has an 8-2 record, 24.21 FPI, and quality wins over LSU, Texas A&M, and Florida State, but lost to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee’s 8-2 résumé includes wins over Alabama and Kentucky and a 21.5 SP+, but the home loss to Texas and road loss to South Carolina count against it.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with 22.6 SP+ and convincing wins over Louisville, SMU, and Virginia, but its home loss to Miami and lower SOS proxy limit its position.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with 19.4 SP+ and wins over Arizona, Houston, and Oklahoma State; its road loss to Cincinnati is the blemish.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with an excellent 0.5409 SOS proxy and wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and TCU, balanced by losses to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7) with a 9-1 record and wins at Alabama and over Ole Miss, the strongest measurable profile in the packet.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama ranks second on SP+ (22.9) and FPI (24.2) with a 8-2 record, and its wins include Florida State and Mississippi State, though the loss to Georgia is noted.
rationales.Miami: Miami has an undefeated-by-ranking-adjusted profile at 9-1 with SP+ 24.4 and FPI 24.3, with a road win at Wake Forest and a win over Florida State.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with SP+ 25.6 and FPI 27.2, its only loss a close road game at BYU, and it beat Miami and Stanford handily.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with SP+ 22.4 and FPI 25.4, a win over Ohio State, and a head-to-head win over Tennessee, offset by losses to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with SP+ 23.1 and FPI 20.8 and a head-to-head win over USC, though its strength of record is thinner than the top tier.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with SP+ 21.7 and FPI 19.4 and no losses, but its wins are mostly against middling opponents and its schedule proxy is modest.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with SP+ 21.1 and FPI 12.6, with a road win at Oregon and the lone loss at Michigan.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon has SP+ 18.3 and FPI 21.3, a win over USC and Ohio State, offset by losses to UCLA and Illinois.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State has SP+ 24.1 and FPI 23.2 but a 7-4 record with losses to Texas, USC, and Oregon, which the metrics do not fully offset.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with SP+ 21.5 and FPI 19.1, anchored by a win over Alabama and a loss only to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4 and FPI 17.1, a clean record with the only loss at Cincinnati, though its schedule proxy is the weakest among the 12.

rationales.Utah: The undefeated 10-0 Utes take the top seed backed by a direct head-to-head win over contender BYU.
rationales.Georgia: At 9-1 against an elite slate, Georgia's direct 20-17 road victory over Alabama anchors their high placement.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA earned the third spot with a sparkling 10-1 record highlighted by a 17-15 head-to-head road win over Oregon.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame stands at 10-1 with a direct head-to-head 31-24 victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami's stellar 9-1 resume is secured in the top five by an authoritative 33-20 direct road win over Wake Forest.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's 9-1 mark features key direct head-to-head wins over ranked opponents Houston and Arizona.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest sits at 9-1 with their only defeat coming to Miami, validated by an impressive 30-27 road win over Louisville.
rationales.BYU: BYU claims this position with an 8-2 record bolstered by a pivotal 28-24 head-to-head victory over Notre Dame.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is placed ahead of Alabama based on their head-to-head 26-10 home victory over the Crimson Tide.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama slots right behind Tennessee at 8-2 with quality wins over Kentucky and LSU outweighing tough defeats.
rationales.Texas: Texas boasts marquee wins including a head-to-head victory over Tennessee, but their two losses keep them just behind the SEC contenders.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana takes the final playoff spot at 8-2, powered by a 27-13 head-to-head victory over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best resume in the packet: a road win at Alabama, a neutral rout of Florida, a 42-7 win at Ole Miss, and only a three-point home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Tennessee on the road, Ohio State at home, and Ole Miss at home, with its two losses coming by three points each to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's road wins at Kentucky, LSU, Mississippi State and Vanderbilt plus a home rout of Texas A&M outweigh narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10, handled Kentucky, LSU and Texas A&M, and its only losses are a three-point home game to Texas and a road trip to South Carolina.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, Cincinnati, Iowa State and TCU, though the packet's schedule proxy is thinner than the SEC contenders'.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest, a 41-13 win at Clemson, and only a road loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes a home win over Miami and a neutral rout of Wisconsin, offset by the road loss at BYU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC and Michigan and lost by four at home to Ohio State and by three at Washington, a strong Big Ten body of work.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and a one-point loss at Michigan, though the packet's schedule proxy is modest.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona at home and won at TCU and Kansas, with losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Baylor, its lone loss a road game at Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win at Louisville and lopsided wins over SMU, Stanford and Virginia, losing only to Miami at home.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet's best profile: wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Florida and Missouri, and the top SP+ and FPI marks.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 in SEC play with a win at Ohio State plus Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, and its only losses are one-point and three-point games.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 SEC body of work — Florida State, Texas A&M, LSU, South Carolina and Vanderbilt — outweighs two narrow losses, and the committee gives the SEC schedule its due.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama plus Auburn, LSU and Texas A&M, and its only losses are by a combined six points.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, Iowa State and TCU, an unblemished record that earns a top-four seed.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and blowouts of Wisconsin, Stanford and SMU, its lone loss a four-point road game at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win over Wake Forest and dominant ACC victories over Clemson, Pittsburgh and Florida State.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, its two losses by a combined eight points.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and lopsided wins over SMU, Virginia and Stanford, its only loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State, its lone loss a road game at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame plus Arizona, Arizona State and TCU, though the Utah and UCF losses cap its ceiling.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 but its wins over Ohio State, USC and Boise State show a top-tier ceiling despite three narrow losses.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs the packet's top FPI and SP+ marks with a 9-1 record and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with the second-best FPI among candidates and quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and LSU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan, and Northwestern, earning a systematic benefit of the doubt.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record features wins over Ohio State, USC, Michigan, and Nebraska despite a demanding slate.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State remains 7-4 but owns wins over Iowa, Indiana, and Illinois, with a strong FPI and Big Ten schedule context.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, and Maryland, though its schedule proxy is more modest.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record and top-three FPI include wins over Miami, Wisconsin, and Michigan State, with only a BYU loss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, and Arkansas and no notable losses in the packet.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 body of work includes wins over Kentucky, LSU, Florida State, and Mississippi State despite losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with wins over Alabama, Auburn, LSU, and Kentucky, offset by a close loss to Texas.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 Big Ten record includes wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern, and Illinois, though it lost to Ohio State.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Duke, and Pittsburgh, losing only to Notre Dame.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs the packet's top FPI and SP+ marks with a 9-1 record and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over USC, Nebraska, and Michigan plus a narrow loss to Ohio State.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 Big Ten body of work includes wins over Ohio State, USC, and Michigan State, giving it the conference's strongest case.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA went 10-1 in the Big Ten, beat Oregon head-to-head, and posted wins over Wisconsin, Illinois, and Maryland.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State earned quality wins over Iowa, Indiana, and Illinois, though losses to Oregon, USC, and Nebraska temper its case.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 Big Ten record includes wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, and Illinois, with only losses to Ohio State and Minnesota.
rationales.Texas: Texas reached 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, losing only to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 résumé features wins over Kentucky, LSU, Florida State, and Mississippi State despite losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record includes a dominant Stanford win and a head-to-head victory over Wake Forest, with its only loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with no notable losses and wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, and Arkansas.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame went 10-1, beat Miami head-to-head, and earned decisive wins over Wisconsin, Stanford, and Michigan State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record includes wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky, and LSU, with only narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss and the packet's strongest ratings profile, with its only blemish a one-point home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, and Iowa State, though its schedule strength is modest and one-score margins introduce some uncertainty.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant victories over Wisconsin, SMU, and Stanford, its lone loss a close road game at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win over Wake Forest and a rout of Clemson, its only loss a competitive game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, and Ole Miss, and its two losses (Oklahoma, Florida) were each by one score.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and competitive play against Ohio State, though the Washington loss tempers the profile.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with quality wins over LSU, South Carolina, and Florida State, but head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee hold it back.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama and wins over Auburn and LSU, offset by narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and lopsided wins over SMU, Virginia, and Stanford, its only loss to Miami.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and Arizona, though losses to Utah and UCF create some doubt.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona, its only loss a road upset at Cincinnati.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 but owns wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State, with all three losses by one score.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's lone loss came to Auburn, but it owns direct wins at Alabama (20-17), over Florida (27-8 neutral), and at Ole Miss (42-7), the best head-to-head ledger in the field.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 and swept its direct tests, beating BYU 28-20, Houston 21-13, and Arizona 40-39 on the road, so no comparable resume can override those results.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes a 31-24 home win over Miami; its only loss was a 24-28 road decision at BYU, and the Miami result anchors this spot.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 road win at Oregon; its only loss was 16-18 at Michigan, and the direct Oregon result outweighs Oregon's stronger schedule.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a road win at Wake Forest (33-20) and a 41-13 rout at Clemson; its lone loss came 24-31 at Notre Dame, which keeps it just below the Irish.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Tennessee 20-17 on the road, Ohio State 24-23, and Ole Miss 34-27; the 24-27 home loss to Florida is the counterweight, but the win volume is stronger.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC 27-13 and lost narrowly to Ohio State 15-19 at home; the direct win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan support this placement.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Kentucky 34-6, but lost 17-20 at home to Texas, so the head-to-head with Texas caps it here.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record includes a 45-17 road win at Kentucky and a 31-13 win at LSU, but direct losses to Georgia and Tennessee keep it below both.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona 28-17, but the 20-28 loss at Utah and a 31-39 loss at UCF leave it behind the Utes and Irish.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with direct wins over Houston (28-26) and Arizona (34-26); the only loss was 24-37 at Cincinnati, and the head-to-head wins drive this slot.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest beat Louisville 30-27 on the road but lost 20-33 at home to Miami, so the Miami result outweighs the Louisville win in placing the Demon Deacons.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia passes every visual test with dominant blowouts over Oklahoma and Ole Miss alongside a gritty road win at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains undefeated with an electric, clutch offense evidenced by putting up 40 on Arizona and handling BYU with authority.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame looks like a complete juggernaut with a signature win over Miami and multiple 30-plus point demolitions.
rationales.Miami: Miami's high-powered attack has dismantled quality opponents by double digits, suffering its only loss on the road in South Bend.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama features overpowering physical performances and huge margin SEC victories, with its only losses coming against Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Texas: Texas controls games with an explosive scoring profile, owning high-level wins over Tennessee and Ohio State.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA has proven its mettle by beating Oregon on the road and consistently suppressing opponents with a stifling defense.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee possesses an imposing, physical style displayed in a decisive 26-10 beatdown of Alabama.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech's blistering offense routinely overwhelms opponents, racking up 50-plus points in dominant Big 12 victories.
