rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks remarkably polished and explosive, stringing together lopsided 40- and 50-point conference routs.
rationales.BYU: BYU owns impressive head-to-head triumphs against Notre Dame and Arizona while physically controlling the line of scrimmage.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's well-rounded squad visually controls the pace, highlighted by a commanding 27-13 victory over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's wins over Alabama (20-17), Florida (27-8) and Ole Miss (42-7) show dominant control against elite SEC opponents, with a lone one-score loss to Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 mark includes wins over Miami, Wisconsin (41-13) and Stanford (58-7), and its margins are consistently decisive.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a 43-35 win over Florida State and a 52-23 blowout of Pittsburgh, and its only loss came by seven points at Notre Dame.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC 27-13 and Ohio State 19-15 on the road, with a 52-16 win over North Texas and a 47-15 rout of Rutgers.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State 24-23 and Ole Miss 34-27, though it lost to Florida 24-27 at home, so its record includes some tight games.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins over Tennessee-adjacent competition are offset by a 17-20 loss to Georgia and a 10-26 loss at Tennessee, so its profile is solid but uneven.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, but its wins were often close (40-39 at Arizona, 21-13 over Houston, 28-20 over BYU), which tempers its ranking.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State beat Iowa 31-14 and Indiana 19-15 on the road but lost by 12 to Oregon and by 12 to USC, which keeps it below the top tier.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 win at Oregon and a 54-3 win at Maryland, though its lone loss came by two at Michigan.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with close wins over Houston and Arizona and a 53-48 shootout win over West Virginia, but its profile lacks a marquee win.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Texas A&M 22-7 on the road, with a 20-17 loss to Texas, giving a strong but not dominant résumé.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's record is 7-3 with its best win at Ohio State and two losses to ranked-tier teams, so its profile is slightly below the teams ahead.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia’s 9-1 record includes road wins over Alabama and Ole Miss and a neutral-site win over Florida, with its only loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, owns wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona, and has no listed losses.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with wins over Miami and SMU, though its road loss to BYU is a significant blemish.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 mark includes a road win over Wake Forest and wins over Clemson and Florida State; its only loss was at Notre Dame.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1, beat Oregon on the road and lost narrowly at Michigan, although the packet’s SOS proxy is relatively modest.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee and Ole Miss, but losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper that résumé.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has an 8-2 record and wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska, while its narrow home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington count against it.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee’s wins over Alabama and LSU stand out, but it also lost to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 and has notable wins over Arizona, Houston and Oklahoma State; its loss at Cincinnati keeps it below the leading unbeaten teams.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win at Louisville and a decisive win over SMU, but its home loss to Miami and modest SOS context hold it back.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon’s wins over Ohio State, USC and Boise State are strong, but losses to UCLA, Illinois and Oklahoma State leave it at 7-3.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has strong wins over LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee leave it 8-2.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays No. 1: 9-1 with the only blemish a one-point Auburn loss, plus head-to-head wins over Alabama, Florida and a 42-7 rout of Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with quality wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona and Iowa State, the packet's only unbeaten resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's lone loss is a four-point road defeat at BYU, backed by wins over Miami, Wisconsin and SMU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with its only loss to Notre Dame, including a 41-13 win at Clemson and a win over Wake Forest.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a head-to-head win at Oregon, though the weakest schedule among the elite tempers the record.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee and Ole Miss, its losses coming by a combined six points.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with both losses by one score to Ohio State and Washington, plus a win over USC.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's two losses are to Georgia and Tennessee, offset by wins over LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a home win over Alabama and losses only to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with its only loss to Miami, including road wins at Louisville and SMU.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with the lone loss at Cincinnati, plus wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and losses only to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet’s best FPI and SP+ marks, and its wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss outweigh its lone loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, has no listed losses, and its wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston strengthen an already strong efficiency profile.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame’s 10-1 record, top-tier FPI/SP+, and head-to-head win over Miami offset its loss to BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 record and high FPI/SP+ accompany wins over Wake Forest and Clemson, with Notre Dame its only loss.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and beat Oregon head-to-head, while its SP+ is elite despite a less impressive FPI and a loss to Michigan.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with strong FPI/SP+ and wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, Ole Miss, and LSU, though Oklahoma and Florida handed it losses.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with high FPI/SP+ and wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska; its narrow Ohio State loss and Washington defeat are the blemishes.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee’s 8-2 resume includes decisive wins over Alabama and Kentucky plus LSU, while its Texas and South Carolina losses temper the strong ratings.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has strong FPI/SP+ and several quality wins, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee leave it behind the teams with better records or direct results.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with strong efficiency ratings and wins over Arizona and Houston, though its loss to Cincinnati and lighter SOS weigh against a higher spot.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with high FPI/SP+ and a win over Louisville, but its Miami loss and comparatively modest SOS constrain its placement.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with two strong head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona, but Utah beat it and its SP+/FPI trail those above.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads SP+ at 31.3 and FPI at 28.7, with a 9-1 record including road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has SP+ 22.9 and FPI 24.2, with a 45-17 win at Kentucky and a home win over Florida State.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with SP+ 21.7 and FPI 19.4, and its only close wins came on the road against Arizona and Cincinnati.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4 and a 28-26 home win over Houston plus a 34-26 win over Arizona.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with SP+ 23.1 and FPI 20.8, though its loss at Ohio State and its Washington loss are the main drags.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with SP+ 24.4, a 52-23 home win over Pittsburgh and a 43-35 win over Florida State; its one loss is to Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with SP+ 22.4 and a 24-23 home win over Ohio State, but its two losses are to Florida and Oklahoma.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with SP+ 25.6 and FPI 27.2, and its only loss is a 24-28 road game at BYU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with SP+ 21.1 and a 17-15 road win at Oregon, though its loss to Michigan is a weakness.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State has SP+ 24.1 and FPI 23.2, but it is 7-4 with losses to Texas, USC, Oregon and Nebraska.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 with SP+ 18.3 and a 41-28 win at Ohio State, but its losses to Illinois and Oklahoma State weigh it down.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with SP+ 21.5 and wins over Alabama and Kentucky, though its losses are to Texas and South Carolina.

rationales.Utah: The undefeated Utes hold the top spot behind direct head-to-head victories over BYU and Houston.
rationales.Georgia: A 9-1 record features elite head-to-head victories over Alabama and Florida.
rationales.UCLA: At 10-1 in the Big Ten, UCLA's direct 17-15 road win over Oregon cements their top-tier standing.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's dominant 10-1 campaign is highlighted by a 31-24 head-to-head victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami boasts a stellar 9-1 record with an emphatic 33-20 direct road win at Wake Forest.
rationales.Alabama: Despite two defeats, Alabama owns a 45-17 road head-to-head win over Kentucky and a win against LSU.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee claims this position on the back of their decisive 26-10 head-to-head triumph over Alabama.
rationales.Texas: Texas holds head-to-head wins over Tennessee and Ohio State, offset slightly by their direct defeat to Florida.
rationales.BYU: BYU's resume features a marquee 28-24 head-to-head victory over Notre Dame and a direct win over Arizona.
rationales.Texas Tech: At 9-1, Texas Tech's strong conference slate includes head-to-head victories over Houston and Arizona.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's exceptional 9-1 season is highlighted by a 30-27 direct road victory over Louisville.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana holds an 8-2 record with a decisive 27-13 head-to-head victory over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best SEC resume: road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss, a neutral-site win over Florida, and only a one-score home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, so the unbeaten record and head-to-head results keep the Utes at two.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Tennessee on the road, handled Ole Miss, and edged Ohio State, with both losses coming by three points.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's road wins at LSU and Kentucky plus home wins over Texas A&M and South Carolina outweigh close losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is at Notre Dame, and the Hurricanes added a road win at Wake Forest plus a road rout of Clemson.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head and won at North Carolina, with the lone loss a four-point road defeat at BYU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon, a win over Wisconsin, and only an 18-16 road loss at Michigan.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC and Michigan and lost to Ohio State by four and Washington by three, giving the Hoosiers a strong Big Ten case.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama and Kentucky and won at Texas A&M, with both losses coming by three points apiece.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona at home and won at TCU and Kansas, with a road loss at Utah and a road loss at UCF.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's lone loss is to Miami, and the Demon Deacons beat Louisville on the road and dominated SMU, Stanford, and Virginia.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston and Arizona and a road win at Oklahoma State, with only a road loss at Cincinnati.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with the packet's best resume: wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Florida, and Missouri, and the top FPI and SP+ marks.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 in the SEC with a win over Ohio State, road wins at Tennessee, LSU, and Missouri, and only one-score losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 SEC body of work includes Florida State, Texas A&M, LSU, and South Carolina wins, with its only losses by a combined six points to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama plus wins over Auburn, LSU, and Kentucky, and narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 in the ACC with a win over Wake Forest and dominant wins over Clemson, Florida State, and Pittsburgh, its only loss a close one at Notre Dame.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, though its schedule proxy trails the SEC contenders.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami, but the head-to-head loss to BYU and a lighter schedule proxy hold it behind the undefeated and one-loss Power champions.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and close losses only to Ohio State and Washington in a strong Big Ten slate.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a road win over Louisville and blowout wins over SMU, Virginia, and California, its lone loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, and Arizona State, its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona, but losses to Utah and UCF temper the profile.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a win at Oregon, but a narrow loss at Michigan and the weakest schedule proxy among the one-loss group keep it mid-pack.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia pairs the packet's top FPI and SP+ marks with a 9-1 record and wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with elite efficiency and quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, with only a narrow Oklahoma loss.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over Nebraska, Michigan, Northwestern, and USC, plus top-tier efficiency metrics.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record and 0.6091 strength-of-schedule proxy are strengthened by wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State has the best candidate strength-of-schedule proxy at 0.5587 and wins over Iowa and Indiana despite four losses.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with an eight-game winning streak, a win over Oregon, and strong wins over Wisconsin, Illinois, and Maryland.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 8-2 with wins over Michigan, Washington, Wisconsin, and Illinois, earning the benefit of the doubt for its Big Ten schedule.
rationales.USC: USC's 8-3 record includes a 0.5446 strength-of-schedule proxy and a marquee win over Ohio State, offset by losses to Oregon and Indiana.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 campaign features eight notable wins and a win over LSU, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee prevent a top-eight placement.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with no notable losses, quality wins over Arkansas and Cincinnati, and a 40-39 road win over Arizona.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with the second-best candidate SP+ mark and eight notable wins, its only loss coming against Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with the packet's second-highest FPI and wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Stanford, and Michigan State.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 body includes wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, Oklahoma and Missouri, giving it the packet's strongest collection of quality victories.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant wins over Wisconsin, Stanford and Michigan State, though its BYU loss prevents perfection.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 but owns quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, LSU and Missouri, giving it the best résumé outside Georgia.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State goes 7-4 with wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois and Northwestern, and the packet's Big Ten benefit supports its case despite four losses.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Northwestern, plus a strong efficiency profile that makes its two losses more tolerable.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 and has beaten Ohio State, USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Michigan State, presenting a strong Big Ten case despite its three losses.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 8-2 with wins over Michigan, Washington, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois, and its Big Ten schedule quality warrants the benefit of the doubt.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois, Maryland and Michigan State, making its lone loss to Michigan the only blemish.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 and has beaten Wake Forest, Clemson, Duke, Stanford, Pittsburgh and Florida State, with its narrow loss to Notre Dame the lone defeat.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 without a loss, and wins over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati, Arkansas and TCU give the undefeated team a convincing résumé.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with quality wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, while its losses to Texas and South Carolina keep it below the leaders.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 and owns wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, Baylor, TCU and Iowa State, with only Utah and UCF defeating it.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Alabama, Florida, and Ole Miss and the packet's strongest ratings profile; the lone Auburn loss is the only blemish, though I note some uncertainty about one game defining a resume.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, Iowa State, TCU, and Arkansas, making it the only unbeaten candidate and a clear top-four seed.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU; the two losses (Oklahoma, Florida) are close and its schedule strength is among the best in the packet.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a win over Wake Forest and strong victories over Clemson, Florida State, and Pittsburgh; its only loss is a competitive road game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a win over Miami and dominant victories over Wisconsin, SMU, and Stanford; the single loss at BYU is the main question mark, acknowledged here.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and narrow losses only to Ohio State and Washington, both competitive; its overall body of work remains strong.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, and Florida State, but head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee keep it out of the top four.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a win over Louisville and blowout victories over SMU, Virginia, and Stanford; the lone loss to Miami is its only setback.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama and wins over Auburn, LSU, and Kentucky; losses to Texas and South Carolina were both by one score.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame and Arizona plus wins over Arizona State, Iowa State, and TCU; losses to Utah and UCF temper the profile.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona, Arizona State, and Oklahoma State; the lone loss to Cincinnati is the only mark against an otherwise strong resume.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 7-3 but with elite wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State; three close losses keep it below the one- and two-loss teams above.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's lone loss to Auburn is offset by direct wins over Alabama (20-17), Florida (27-8), and Ole Miss (42-7) plus the strongest overall profile.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 and won every head-to-head that matters, beating BYU 28-20, Houston 21-13, and Arizona 40-39, so it stays ahead of those teams.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss came at BYU 24-28, but it beat Miami 31-24 head-to-head, and that direct result plus a 10-1 record keeps the Irish ahead of Miami.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 case rests on beating Oregon 17-15 head-to-head and a road win at Michigan State, with only an 18-16 loss to Michigan.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 mark with wins at Clemson and Wake Forest (33-20) is strong, but the head-to-head loss at Notre Dame keeps it below the Irish.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Tennessee 20-17 away and Ohio State 24-23, but the 27-24 home loss to Florida is a direct result that complicates its case against the Gators.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10 and Kentucky 34-6 head-to-head, and its only losses are a 20-17 home loss to Texas and a road loss at South Carolina.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 45-17 win at Kentucky and 31-13 win at LSU are quality road results, but head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee cap its placement.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC 27-13 but lost 19-15 to Ohio State, so the Buckeyes' direct win outweighs the Trojans result and keeps Indiana just outside the top eight.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona 28-17 head-to-head, but the 20-28 loss at Utah and the UCF loss limit how high the Cougars can climb.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest beat Louisville 30-27 away and owns a 9-1 record, but the 33-20 home loss to Miami is the direct result that keeps it below the Hurricanes.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 and beat Houston 28-26 and Arizona 34-26 head-to-head, though the lone loss at Cincinnati and weaker schedule strength temper the case.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia passes every visual test with dominant blowouts over Oklahoma and Ole Miss alongside a gritty road win at Alabama.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains undefeated with an explosive, versatile offense that dismantled Arkansas and edged top competition in hostile environments.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame looks ferocious on both sides of the ball, blowing out Wisconsin and Stanford while handing Miami its lone defeat.
rationales.Miami: Miami features a blistering offense that crushed Clemson and Wake Forest by double digits.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama possesses elite talent that demolished LSU and Mississippi State, with both defeats coming in tight, high-caliber SEC battles.
rationales.Texas: Texas controls games with decisive physical wins over Tennessee and Ohio State plus a dominant 45-3 showing over Arkansas.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA boasts a rock-solid defense and a massive signature road win in Eugene against Oregon.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee plays stifling defense and asserted dominance over Alabama in an emphatic 26-10 victory.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech displays an unstoppable high-scoring attack that put up 50-plus points in multiple Big 12 victories.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks remarkably sharp with ruthless 40-plus point blowouts against conference foes and a key win at Louisville.
rationales.BYU: BYU proved its high ceiling by knocking off Notre Dame and Arizona with disciplined, physical play.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana displays a crisp, efficient system highlighted by a convincing two-touchdown victory over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 mark includes a dominant 27-8 neutral win over Florida and a 20-17 road win at Alabama, with its only loss a one-score home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 and won its close games in the packet, including a 40-39 road win at Arizona and a 28-20 win over BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State 24-23 and Ole Miss 34-27 while its only losses were narrow one-score defeats to Florida and a 24-27 neutral loss to Oklahoma.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a 43-35 home win over Florida State and wins by 19, 27 and 29 points, with its lone loss a 24-31 road defeat to Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is a 24-28 road game at BYU, and it won by margins of 17 at Miami and 35 at home against Navy.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins are mostly comfortable, including a 49-18 home rout of South Carolina and a 56-23 road win at Mississippi State, offset by a 10-26 loss at Tennessee.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a 52-16 rout of North Texas and a 47-15 road win at Rutgers, though it lost 15-19 at home to Ohio State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record includes a 26-10 home win over Alabama and a 24-14 win over Auburn, with losses to Texas (17-20) and South Carolina (24-27).
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with close wins over Houston (28-26) and Arizona (34-26) and a 53-48 shootout win over West Virginia, but its only loss came at Cincinnati.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 road win at Oregon and a 17-7 home win over Wisconsin, and its one defeat was a 16-18 road loss to Michigan.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a 57-3 rout of Stanford and a 50-29 road win over Georgia Tech, and it lost only once, 20-33 at home to Miami.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's four losses are concentrated against Texas (23-24), USC (18-30), Oregon (28-41) and Nebraska (28-31), with the 31-14 win at Iowa its best road result.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record includes road wins over Alabama and Ole Miss, while its sole loss was a narrow home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0, with wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona and no losses to offset its strong record.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1, and its win over Miami plus decisive victories over SMU and Wisconsin outweigh a four-point loss at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 mark features wins over Clemson, Wake Forest and Florida State; its only loss was at Notre Dame.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 and owns a road win over Oregon, with its only defeat a two-point loss at Michigan.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with valuable wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and LSU, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it below the top tier.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record includes wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska, but its narrow home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington matter.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama and LSU and is 8-2, though its close home loss to Texas and road loss at South Carolina restrain its placement.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Arizona, Houston and Baylor; its only loss came on the road at Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a win at Louisville and several convincing victories, but its home loss to Miami is a notable blemish.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has an 8-2 record and strong wins over LSU, Florida State and Texas A&M, but lost to both Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with wins over Notre Dame, Arizona and TCU, while losses to Utah and UCF leave it behind the leading one-loss teams.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 with wins over Alabama, Florida and Ole Miss and the packet's best ratings profile, anchoring the top spot.
rationales.Utah: Utah is a perfect 10-0 with head-to-head wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona, validating the No. 2 slot.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a marquee win over Miami and dominant victories over Wisconsin, Stanford and SMU.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and the only loss a one-point game at Michigan, supporting the top-four bye.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Florida State, its lone loss a competitive road game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with a win over USC and narrow losses only to Ohio State and Washington, keeping it firmly in the at-large mix.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 resume includes wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina and Florida State, offsetting losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee and Ole Miss, though the Oklahoma and Florida losses temper its ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a head-to-head win over Alabama and wins over Auburn, LSU and Kentucky, with close losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with its lone loss to Miami and a strong stretch of wins over Louisville, SMU and Virginia.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona, its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with a signature win over Notre Dame plus wins over Arizona, Iowa State and Baylor, despite losses to Utah and UCF.
